notes.title: Version 2
notes.notes: [p]Hello Job-Seekers,[/p][p][/p][p]Wow! It's been 3 whole years since we released the original Mangotronics Employment Collection, can you believe it?[/p][p]I'm so proud of all the things we've accomplished and now, I'm thrilled to be able to announce a huge update- Version 2![/p][p]With Version 2 comes new features, new games by new indie developers, and a completely overhauled launcher UI built from a new engine in a "Fake OS" style so you can organize your in-launcher game collection however you want.[/p][p]Here's what to expect in the update:[/p][list][*][p]10 new games [/p][/*][*][p]10 new devs[/p][/*][*][p]100% FREE![/p][/*][*][p]New launcher featuring Mango OS[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Deck support[/p][/*][*][p]A secret 11th game?[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Version 2 is a free content update for everyone who already owns The Mangotronics Employment Collection, bringing the total up to 19 games and demos.[/p][p]The release date will be announced as soon as we have a complete, tested and working build.[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support throughout the last 3 years, and here's to an amazing 3 more![/p][p][/p][p]Welcome to the Team![/p][p]-Matt from Mangotronics[/p]
